name: Starter hymns (English)
note: Public-domain hymn texts (authors and translators died before 1956).

songs.title: A Mighty Fortress Is Our God
songs.author: Martin Luther (1483–1546); tr. Frederic H. Hedge (1805–1890)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A mighty fortress is our God,
A bulwark never failing;
Our helper He, amid the flood
Of mortal ills prevailing:
For still our ancient foe
Doth seek to work us woe;
His craft and power are great,
And, armed with cruel hate,
On earth is not his equal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Did we in our own strength confide,
Our striving would be losing;
Were not the right Man on our side,
The Man of God's own choosing:
Dost ask who that may be?
Christ Jesus, it is He;
Lord Sabaoth, His name,
From age to age the same,
And He must win the battle.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And though this world, with devils filled,
Should threaten to undo us,
We will not fear, for God hath willed
His truth to triumph through us:
The Prince of Darkness grim,
We tremble not for him;
His rage we can endure,
For lo, his doom is sure,
One little word shall fell him.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: That word above all earthly powers,
No thanks to them, abideth;
The Spirit and the gifts are ours
Through Him who with us sideth:
Let goods and kindred go,
This mortal life also;
The body they may kill:
God's truth abideth still,
His kingdom is forever.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Abide with me!
Fast falls the eventide;
The darkness thickens:
Lord, with me abide.
When other helpers fail,
And comforts flee,
Help of the helpless,
O abide with me!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Swift to its close
Ebbs out life's little day;
Earth's joys grow dim,
Its glories pass away;
Change and decay
In all around I see;
O Thou who changest not,
Abide with me!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I need Thy presence
Every passing hour.
What but Thy grace
Can foil the tempter's power?
Who like Thyself
My guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine,
O abide with me!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I fear no foe
With Thee at hand to bless:
Ills have no weight,
And tears no bitterness.
Where is death's sting?
Where, grave, thy victory?
I triumph still,
If Thou abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Hold Thou Thy cross
Before my closing eyes;
Shine through the gloom,
And point me to the skies;
Heav'n's morning breaks,
And earth's vain shadows flee:
In life, in death,
O Lord, abide with me!

songs.title: All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
songs.author: Edward Perronet (1726–1792)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Let angels prostrate fall;
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Crown Him, ye martyrs of your God,
Who from His altar call;
Extol the Stem of Jesse's rod,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ye seed of Israel's chosen race,
Ye ransomed from the fall,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Sinners, whose love can ne'er forget
The wormwood and the gall,
Go spread your trophies at His feet,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Let every tribe and every tongue
Before Him prostrate fall
And shout in universal song
The crowned Lord of all.

songs.title: All People That on Earth Do Dwell
songs.author: Attributed to William Kethe (d. 1594)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice.
Him serve with fear, His praise forth tell;
Come ye before Him and rejoice.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord, ye know, is God indeed;
Without our aid He did us make;
We are His folk, He doth us feed,
And for His sheep He doth us take.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O enter then His gates with praise;
Approach with joy His courts unto;
Praise, laud, and bless His name always,
For it is seemly so to do.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For why? the Lord our God is good;
His mercy is for ever sure;
His truth at all times firmly stood,
And shall from age to age endure.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: To Father, Son and Holy Ghost,
The God whom Heaven and earth adore,
From men and from the angel host
Be praise and glory evermore.

songs.title: All the Way My Saviour Leads Me
songs.author: Fanny Crosby (1820–1915)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All the way my Saviour leads me;
What have I to ask beside?
Can I doubt His tender mercy,
Who through life has been my guide?
Heav'nly peace, divinest comfort,
Here by faith in Him to dwell!
For I know, whate'er befall me,
Jesus doeth all things well;
For I know, whate'er befall me,
Jesus doeth all things well.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All the way my Saviour leads me,
Cheers each winding path I tread;
Gives me grace for every trial,
Feeds me with the living bread.
Though my weary steps may falter,
And my soul athirst may be,
Gushing from the rock before me,
Lo! A spring of joy I see;
Gushing from the rock before me,
Lo! A spring of joy I see.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All the way my Saviour leads me
O the fullness of His love!
Perfect rest to me is promised
In my Father's house above.
When my spirit, clothed immortal,
Wings its flight to realms of day
This my song through endless ages—
Jesus led me all the way;
This my song through endless ages—
Jesus led me all the way.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful:
The Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Each little flower that opens,
Each little bird that sings,
He made their glowing colours,
He made their tiny wings.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful:
The Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The purple headed mountains,
The river running by,
The sunset and the morning
That brightens up the sky.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful:
The Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The cold wind in the winter,
The pleasant summer sun,
The ripe fruits in the garden,
He made them every one.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful:
The Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The tall trees in the greenwood,
The meadows where we play,
The rushes by the water,
To gather every day.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful:
The Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: He gave us eyes to see them,
And lips that we might tell
How great is God Almighty,
Who has made all things well.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful:
The Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Amazing grace! How sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found;
Was blind, but now I see.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Through many dangers, toils and snares,
I have already come;
'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The Lord has promised good to me,
His Word my hope secures;
He will my shield and portion be,
As long as life endures.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Yea, when this flesh and heart shall fail,
And mortal life shall cease,
I shall possess, within the veil,
A life of joy and peace.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: When we've been there ten thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun,
We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we'd first begun.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: And can it be that I should gain
An interest in the Saviour's blood?
Died He for me, who caused His pain—
For me, who Him to death pursued?
Amazing love! How can it be,
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?
Amazing love! How can it be,
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Tis mystery all: th'Immortal dies:
Who can explore His strange design?
In vain the firstborn seraph tries
To sound the depths of love divine.
'Tis mercy all! Let earth adore,
Let angel minds inquire no more.
'Tis mercy all! Let earth adore;
Let angel minds inquire no more.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He left His Father's throne above
So free, so infinite His grace—
Emptied Himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race:
'Tis mercy all, immense and free,
For O my God, it found out me!
'Tis mercy all, immense and free,
For O my God, it found out me!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Long my imprisoned spirit lay,
Fast bound in sin and nature's night;
Thine eye diffused a quickening ray—
I woke, the dungeon flamed with light;
My chains fell off, my heart was free,
I rose, went forth, and followed Thee.
My chains fell off, my heart was free,
I rose, went forth, and followed Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: No condemnation now I dread;
Jesus, and all in Him, is mine;
Alive in Him, my living head,
And clothed in righteousness divine,
Bold I approach th'eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ my own.
Bold I approach th'eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ my own.

songs.title: Angels from the Realms of Glory
songs.author: James Montgomery (1771–1854)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Angels from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o'er all the earth;
Ye who sang creation's story
Now proclaim Messiah's birth.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn king.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shepherds, in the field abiding,
Watching o'er your flocks by night,
God with us is now residing;
Yonder shines the infant light:

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn king.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sages, leave your contemplations,
Brighter visions beam afar;
Seek the great Desire of nations;
Ye have seen His natal star.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn king.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Saints, before the altar bending,
Watching long in hope and fear;
Suddenly the Lord, descending,
In His temple shall appear.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn king.

songs.title: At the Cross (Alas! and Did My Saviour Bleed)
songs.author: Isaac Watts (1674–1748); refrain Ralph E. Hudson (1843–1901)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Alas! and did my Saviour bleed
And did my Sovereign die?
Would He devote that sacred head
For such a worm as I?

sections.label: Chorus
lines: At the cross, at the cross,
Where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Was it for crimes that I had done
He groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity! grace unknown!
And love beyond degree!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: At the cross, at the cross,
Where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Well might the sun in darkness hide
And shut his glories in,
When Christ, the mighty Maker died,
For man the creature's sin.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: At the cross, at the cross,
Where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: But drops of grief can ne'er repay
The debt of love I owe:
Here, Lord, I give my self away
'Tis all that I can do.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: At the cross, at the cross,
Where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: At the name of Jesus,
Every knee shall bow,
Every tongue confess Him
King of glory now;
'Tis the Father's pleasure
We should call Him Lord,
Who from the beginning
Was the mighty Word.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: At His voice creation
Sprang at once to sight,
All the angel faces,
All the hosts of light,
Thrones and wide dominions,
Stars upon their way,
All the heav'nly orders,
In their great array.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Humbled for a season,
To receive a name
From the lips of sinners
Unto whom He came,
Faithfully He bore it,
Spotless to the last,
Brought it back victorious
When from death He passed.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Bore it up triumphant
With its human light,
Through all ranks of creatures,
To the central height,
To the throne of Godhead,
To the Father's breast;
Filled it with the glory
Of that perfect rest.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: In your hearts enthrone Him;
There let Him subdue
All that is not holy,
All that is not true;
Crown Him as your captain
In temptation's hour;
Let His will enfold you
In its light and power.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Brothers, this Lord Jesus
Shall return again,
With His Father's glory,
With His angel train;
For all wreaths of empire
Meet upon His brow,
And our hearts confess Him
King of glory now.

songs.title: Away in a Manger
songs.author: Anonymous (verses 1–2, 1885); verse 3 attributed to John T. McFarland (1851–1913)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Away in a manger,
No crib for a bed,
The little Lord Jesus
Laid down His sweet head.
The stars in the sky
Looked down where He lay,
The little Lord Jesus,
Asleep on the hay.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The cattle are lowing,
The Baby awakes,
But little Lord Jesus,
No crying He makes;
I love Thee, Lord Jesus,
Look down from the sky
And stay by my cradle
Till morning is nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be near me, Lord Jesus,
I ask Thee to stay
Close by me forever,
And love me, I pray;
Bless all the dear children
In Thy tender care,
And fit us for Heaven
To live with Thee there.

songs.title: Be Thou My Vision
songs.author: Old Irish; tr. Mary E. Byrne (1880–1931); versified Eleanor H. Hull (1860–1935)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Be Thou my vision, O Lord of my heart;
Naught be all else to me, save that Thou art.
Thou my best thought, by day or by night,
Waking or sleeping, Thy presence my light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Be Thou my wisdom, and Thou my true word;
I ever with Thee and Thou with me, Lord;
Thou my great Father, I Thy true son;
Thou in me dwelling, and I with Thee one.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be Thou my battle shield, sword for the fight;
Be Thou my dignity, Thou my delight;
Thou my soul's shelter, Thou my high tower:
Raise Thou me heav'nward, O power of my power.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Riches I heed not, nor man's empty praise,
Thou mine inheritance, now and always:
Thou and Thou only, first in my heart,
High King of Heaven, my treasure Thou art.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: High King of Heaven, my victory on,
May I reach Heav'n's joys, O bright Heaven's sun!
Heart of my own heart, whatever befall,
Still be my vision, O Ruler of all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
O what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour, all the day long;
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour, all the day long.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Perfect submission, perfect delight,
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight;
Angels descending bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour, all the day long;
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour, all the day long.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Perfect submission, all is at rest
I in my Saviour am happy and blest,
Watching and waiting, looking above,
Filled with His goodness, lost in His love.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour, all the day long;
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour, all the day long.

songs.title: Blest Be the Tie That Binds
songs.author: John Fawcett (1740–1817)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blest be the tie that binds
Our hearts in Christian love;
The fellowship of kindred minds
Is like to that above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Before our Father's throne
We pour our ardent prayers;
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one
Our comforts and our cares.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We share each other's woes,
Our mutual burdens bear;
And often for each other flows
The sympathizing tear.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When we asunder part,
It gives us inward pain;
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And hope to meet again.

songs.title: Breathe on Me, Breath of God
songs.author: Edwin Hatch (1835–1889)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God,
Fill me with life anew,
That I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God,
Until my heart is pure,
Until with Thee I will one will,
To do and to endure.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God,
Blend all my soul with Thine,
Until this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God,
So shall I never die,
But live with Thee the perfect life
Of Thine eternity.

songs.title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today
songs.author: Charles Wesley (1707–1788)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ the Lord is risen today, Alleluia!
Sons of men and angels say, Alleluia!
Raise your joys and triumphs high, Alleluia!
Sing ye heav'ns, and earth reply, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Love's redeeming work is done, Alleluia!
Fought the fight, the battle won, Alleluia!
Lo! Our sun's eclipse is o'er, Alleluia!
Lo! He sets in blood no more, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Vain the stone, the watch, the seal, Alleluia!
Christ has burst the gates of hell, Alleluia!
Death in vain forbids His rise, Alleluia!
Christ has opened paradise, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lives again our glorious king, Alleluia!
Where, O death, is now thy sting? Alleluia!
Dying once He all doth save, Alleluia!
Where thy victory, O grave? Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Soar we now, where Christ has led, Alleluia!
Following our exalted head, Alleluia!
Made like Him, like Him we rise, Alleluia!
Ours the cross—the grave—the skies, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Thou almighty King,
Help us Thy name to sing,
Help us to praise!
Father all glorious,
O'er all victorious,
Come and reign over us,
Ancient of Days!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come, Thou incarnate Word,
Gird on Thy mighty sword,
Our prayer attend!
Come, and Thy people bless,
And give Thy Word success,
Spirit of holiness,
On us descend!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, holy Comforter,
Thy sacred witness bear
In this glad hour.
Thou who almighty art,
Now rule in every heart,
And ne'er from us depart,
Spirit of power!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To Thee, great One in Three,
Eternal praises be,
Hence, evermore.
Thy sovereign majesty
May we in glory see,
And to eternity
Love and adore!

songs.title: Come, Thou Fount of Every Blessing
songs.author: Robert Robinson (1735–1790)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Thou fount of every blessing,
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace;
Streams of mercy, never ceasing,
Call for songs of loudest praise.
Teach me some melodious sonnet,
Sung by flaming tongues above.
Praise the mount! I'm fixed upon it,
Mount of Thy redeeming love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus sought me when a stranger,
Wandering from the fold of God;
He, to rescue me from danger,
Interposed His precious blood;
How His kindness yet pursues me
Mortal tongue can never tell,
Clothed in flesh, till death shall loose me
I cannot proclaim it well.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be!
Let Thy goodness, like a fetter,
Bind my wandering heart to Thee.
Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it,
Prone to leave the God I love;
Here's my heart, O take and seal it,
Seal it for Thy courts above.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, ye thankful people, come,
Raise the song of harvest-home!
All is safely gathered in,
Ere the winter storms begin:
God our Maker doth provide
For our wants to be supplied;
Come to God's own temple, come,
Raise the song of harvest-home!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We ourselves are God's own field,
Fruit unto His praise to yield;
Wheat and tares together sown
Unto joy or sorrow grown.
First the blade and then the ear,
Then the full corn shall appear;
Grant, O Harvest Lord, that we
Wholesome grain and pure may be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the Lord our God shall come,
And shall take His harvest home;
From His field shall purge away
All that doth offend that day:
Give His angels charge at last
In the fire the tares to cast;
But the fruitful ears to store
In His garner evermore.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then, thou Church triumphant, come,
Bring the song of harvest-home;
All are safely gathered in,
Free from sorrow, free from sin,
There, for ever purified,
In God's garner to abide;
Come, ten thousand angels, come,
Raise the glorious harvest-home!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When upon life's billows
You are tempest tossed,
When you are discouraged,
Thinking all is lost,
Count your many blessings,
Name them one by one,
And it will surprise you
What the Lord hath done.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,
Count your blessings,
See what God hath done!
Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,
And it will surprise you
What the Lord hath done.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Are you ever burdened
With a load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy
You are called to bear?
Count your many blessings,
Every doubt will fly,
And you will keep singing
As the days go by.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,
Count your blessings,
See what God hath done!
Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,
And it will surprise you
What the Lord hath done.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When you look at others
With their lands and gold,
Think that Christ has promised
You His wealth untold;
Count your many blessings.
Wealth can never buy
Your reward in Heaven,
Nor your home on high.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,
Count your blessings,
See what God hath done!
Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,
And it will surprise you
What the Lord hath done.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So, amid the conflict
Whether great or small,
Do not be disheartened,
God is over all;
Count your many blessings,
Angels will attend,
Help and comfort give you
To your journey's end.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,
Count your blessings,
See what God hath done!
Count your blessings,
Name them one by one,
And it will surprise you
What the Lord hath done.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Crown Him with many crowns,
The Lamb upon His throne.
Hark! How the heav'nly anthem drowns
All music but its own!
Awake, my soul, and sing
Of Him who died for thee;
And hail Him as thy matchless king
Through all eternity!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Crown Him the Lord of love!
Behold His hands and side,
Those wounds, yet visible above,
In beauty glorified:
No angel in the sky
Can fully bear that sight,
But downward bends his burning eye
At mysteries so bright!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Crown Him the Lord of peace!
Whose power a scepter sways
From pole to pole, that wars may cease,
Absorbed in prayer and praise:
His reign shall know no end,
And round His pierced feet
Fair flowers of paradise extend
Their fragrance ever sweet.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Crown Him the Lord of years,
The Potentate of time,
Creator of the rolling spheres,
Ineffably sublime.
All hail, Redeemer, hail!
For Thou hast died for me;
Thy praise and glory shall not fail
Throughout eternity.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Crown Him the Lord of life,
Who triumphed o'er the grave,
And rose victorious in the strife
For those He came to save.
His glories now we sing,
Who died, and rose on high,
Who died eternal life to bring,
And lives that death may die.

songs.title: Dear Lord and Father of Mankind
songs.author: John Greenleaf Whittier (1807–1892)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Dear Lord and Father of mankind,
Forgive our foolish ways;
Reclothe us in our rightful mind,
In purer lives Thy service find,
In deeper reverence, praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In simple trust like theirs who heard,
Beside the Syrian sea,
The gracious calling of the Lord,
Let us, like them, without a word,
Rise up and follow Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Sabbath rest by Galilee,
O calm of hills above,
Where Jesus knelt to share with Thee
The silence of eternity,
Interpreted by love!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Drop Thy still dews of quietness,
Till all our strivings cease;
Take from our souls the strain and stress,
And let our ordered lives confess
The beauty of Thy peace.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Breathe through the heats of our desire
Thy coolness and Thy balm;
Let sense be dumb, let flesh retire;
Speak through the earthquake, wind, and fire,
O still, small voice of calm.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Eternal Father, strong to save,
Whose arm hath bound the restless wave,
Who bidd'st the mighty ocean deep
Its own appointed limits keep;
Oh, hear us when we cry to Thee,
For those in peril on the sea!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Christ! Whose voice the waters heard
And hushed their raging at Thy Word,
Who walked upon the foaming deep,
And calm amidst its rage didst sleep;
Oh, hear us when we cry to Thee,
For those in peril on the sea!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Most Holy Spirit! Who didst brood
Upon the chaos dark and rude,
And bid its angry tumult cease,
And give, for wild confusion, peace;
Oh, hear us when we cry to Thee,
For those in peril on the sea!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Trinity of love and power!
Our family shield in danger's hour;
From rock and tempest, fire and foe,
Protect us wheresoe'er we go;
Thus evermore shall rise to Thee
Glad hymns of praise from land and sea.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Fight the good fight with all thy might;
Christ is thy strength, and Christ thy right;
Lay hold on life, and it shall be
Thy joy and crown eternally.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Run the straight race through God's good grace,
Lift up thine eyes, and seek His face;
Life with its way before us lies,
Christ is the path, and Christ the prize.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Cast care aside, upon thy guide,
Lean, and His mercy will provide;
Lean, and the trusting soul shall prove
Christ is its life, and Christ its love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Faint not nor fear, His arms are near,
He changeth not, and thou art dear.
Only believe, and thou shalt see
That Christ is all in all to thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For all the saints,
Who from their labours rest,
Who Thee by faith
Before the world confessed,
Thy name, O Jesus,
Be forever blessed.
Alleluia, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou wast their rock,
Their fortress and their might;
Thou, Lord, their captain
In the well fought fight;
Thou, in the darkness drear,
Their one true Light.
Alleluia, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O blest communion,
Fellowship divine!
We feebly struggle,
They in glory shine;
All are one in Thee,
For all are Thine.
Alleluia, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O may Thy soldiers,
Faithful, true and bold,
Fight as the saints
Who nobly fought of old,
And win with them
The victor's crown of gold.
Alleluia, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: And when the strife
Is fierce, the warfare long,
Steals on the ear
The distant triumph song,
And hearts are brave,
Again, and arms are strong.
Alleluia, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: The golden evening
Brightens in the west;
Soon, soon to faithful
Warriors comes their rest;
Sweet is the calm
Of paradise the blessed.
Alleluia, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 7
lines: But lo! there breaks
A yet more glorious day;
The saints triumphant
Rise in bright array;
The King of glory
Passes on His way.
Alleluia, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 8
lines: From earth's wide bounds,
From ocean's farthest coast,
Through gates of pearl
Streams in the countless host,
And singing to Father,
Son and Holy Ghost:
Alleluia, Alleluia!

songs.title: Glorious Things of Thee Are Spoken
songs.author: John Newton (1725–1807)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Glorious things of thee are spoken,
Zion, city of our God!
He, whose word cannot be broken,
Formed thee for His own abode.
On the Rock of Ages founded,
What can shake thy sure repose?
With salvation's walls surrounded,
Thou may'st smile at all thy foes.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See! the streams of living waters,
Springing from eternal love;
Well supply thy sons and daughters,
And all fear of want remove:
Who can faint while such a river
Ever flows their thirst t'assuage?
Grace, which like the Lord, the giver,
Never fails from age to age.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Round each habitation hovering,
See the cloud and fire appear!
For a glory and a covering
Showing that the Lord is near.
Thus deriving from our banner
Light by night and shade by day;
Safe they feed upon the manna
Which He gives them when they pray.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Saviour, if of Zion's city,
I through grace a member am,
Let the world deride or pity,
I will glory in Thy name:
Fading is the worldling's pleasure,
All his boasted pomp and show;
Solid joys and lasting treasure
None but Zion's children know.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Down at the cross where my Saviour died,
Down where for cleansing from sin I cried,
There to my heart was the blood applied;
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Glory to His name, glory to His name:
There to my heart was the blood applied;
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I am so wondrously saved from sin,
Jesus so sweetly abides within;
There at the cross where He took me in;
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Glory to His name, glory to His name:
There to my heart was the blood applied;
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, precious fountain that saves from sin,
I am so glad I have entered in;
There Jesus saves me and keeps me clean;
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Glory to His name, glory to His name:
There to my heart was the blood applied;
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come to this fountain so rich and sweet,
Cast thy poor soul at the Saviour's feet;
Plunge in today, and be made complete;
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Glory to His name, glory to His name:
There to my heart was the blood applied;
Glory to His name!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God rest ye merry, gentlemen,
Let nothing you dismay,
Remember Christ our Saviour
Was born on Christmas Day;
To save us all from Satan's power
When we were gone astray.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O tidings of comfort and joy,
Comfort and joy;
O tidings of comfort and joy.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In Bethlehem, in Israel,
This blessed Babe was born,
And laid within a manger
Upon this blessed morn;
The which His mother Mary
Did nothing take in scorn.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O tidings of comfort and joy,
Comfort and joy;
O tidings of comfort and joy.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: From God our heav'nly Father
A blessed angel came;
And unto certain shepherds
Brought tidings of the same;
How that in Bethlehem was born
The Son of God by name.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O tidings of comfort and joy,
Comfort and joy;
O tidings of comfort and joy.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The shepherds at those tidings
Rejoiced much in mind,
And left their flocks a-feeding
In tempest, storm and wind,
And went to Bethl'em straightaway
This blessed Babe to find.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O tidings of comfort and joy,
Comfort and joy;
O tidings of comfort and joy.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: But when to Bethlehem they came
Where our dear Saviour lay,
They found Him in a manger
Where oxen feed on hay;
His mother Mary kneeling
Unto the Lord did pray.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O tidings of comfort and joy,
Comfort and joy;
O tidings of comfort and joy.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Now to the Lord sing praises
All you within this place,
And with true love and brotherhood
Each other now embrace;
This holy tide of Christmas
All others doth deface.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O tidings of comfort and joy,
Comfort and joy;
O tidings of comfort and joy.

songs.title: Good Christian Men, Rejoice
songs.author: Medieval Latin; tr. John M. Neale (1818–1866)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Good Christian men, rejoice
With heart and soul, and voice;
Give ye heed to what we say:
News! News! Jesus Christ is born today;
Ox and ass before Him bow;
And He is in the manger now.
Christ is born today!
Christ is born today!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Good Christian men, rejoice,
With heart and soul and voice;
Now ye hear of endless bliss:
Joy! Joy! Jesus Christ was born for this!
He has opened the heavenly door,
And man is blest forevermore.
Christ was born for this!
Christ was born for this!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Good Christian men, rejoice,
With heart and soul and voice;
Now ye need not fear the grave:
Peace! Peace! Jesus Christ was born to save!
Calls you one and calls you all,
To gain His everlasting hall.
Christ was born to save!
Christ was born to save!

songs.title: Guide Me, O Thou Great Jehovah
songs.author: William Williams (1717–1791); tr. Peter Williams (1723–1796)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Guide me, O Thou great Jehovah,
Pilgrim through this barren land.
I am weak, but Thou art mighty;
Hold me with Thy powerful hand.
Bread of Heaven, Bread of Heaven,
Feed me till I want no more;
Feed me till I want no more.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Open now the crystal fountain,
Whence the healing stream doth flow;
Let the fire and cloudy pillar
Lead me all my journey through.
Strong deliverer, strong deliverer,
Be Thou still my strength and shield;
Be Thou still my strength and shield.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When I tread the verge of Jordan,
Bid my anxious fears subside;
Death of deaths, and hell's destruction,
Land me safe on Canaan's side.
Songs of praises, songs of praises,
I will ever give to Thee;
I will ever give to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Man of Sorrows! what a name
For the Son of God, who came
Ruined sinners to reclaim.
Hallelujah! What a Saviour!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
In my place condemned He stood;
Sealed my pardon with His blood.
Hallelujah! What a Saviour!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Guilty, vile, and helpless we;
Spotless Lamb of God was He;
Full atonement! can it be?
Hallelujah! What a Saviour!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lifted up was He to die;
It is finished! was His cry;
Now in Heav'n exalted high.
Hallelujah! What a Saviour!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: When He comes, our glorious king,
All His ransomed home to bring,
Then anew His song we'll sing:
Hallelujah! What a Saviour!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark! The herald angels sing,
Glory to the newborn King;
Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
God and sinners reconciled!
Joyful, all ye nations rise,
Join the triumph of the skies;
With th'angelic host proclaim,
Christ is born in Bethlehem!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Hark! the herald angels sing,
Glory to the newborn King!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ, by highest Heav'n adored;
Christ the everlasting Lord;
Late in time, behold Him come,
Offspring of a virgin's womb.
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see;
Hail th'incarnate Deity,
Pleased with us in flesh to dwell,
Jesus our Emmanuel.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Hark! the herald angels sing,
Glory to the newborn King!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Hail the heav'nly Prince of Peace!
Hail the Sun of Righteousness!
Light and life to all He brings,
Ris'n with healing in His wings.
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die.
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Hark! the herald angels sing,
Glory to the newborn King!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Thou art the Potter, I am the clay.
Mold me and make me after Thy will,
While I am waiting, yielded and still.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Search me and try me, Master, today!
Whiter than snow, Lord, wash me just now,
As in Thy presence humbly I bow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Wounded and weary, help me, I pray!
Power, all power, surely is Thine!
Touch me and heal me, Saviour divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Hold o'er my being absolute sway!
Fill with Thy Spirit 'till all shall see
Christ only, always, living in me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He leadeth me, O blessed thought!
O words with heav'nly comfort fraught!
Whate'er I do, where'er I be
Still 'tis God's hand that leadeth me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: He leadeth me, He leadeth me,
By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follower I would be,
For by His hand He leadeth me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sometimes mid scenes of deepest gloom,
Sometimes where Eden's bowers bloom,
By waters still, over troubled sea,
Still 'tis His hand that leadeth me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: He leadeth me, He leadeth me,
By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follower I would be,
For by His hand He leadeth me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, I would place my hand in Thine,
Nor ever murmur nor repine;
Content, whatever lot I see,
Since 'tis my God that leadeth me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: He leadeth me, He leadeth me,
By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follower I would be,
For by His hand He leadeth me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when my task on earth is done,
When by Thy grace the victory's won,
E'en death's cold wave I will not flee,
Since God through Jordan leadeth me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: He leadeth me, He leadeth me,
By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follower I would be,
For by His hand He leadeth me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I'm pressing on the upward way,
New heights I'm gaining every day;
Still praying as I'm onward bound,
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Lord, lift me up and let me stand,
By faith, on Heaven's table land,
A higher plane than I have found;
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My heart has no desire to stay
Where doubts arise and fears dismay;
Though some may dwell where those abound,
My prayer, my aim, is higher ground.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Lord, lift me up and let me stand,
By faith, on Heaven's table land,
A higher plane than I have found;
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I want to live above the world,
Though Satan's darts at me are hurled;
For faith has caught the joyful sound,
The song of saints on higher ground.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Lord, lift me up and let me stand,
By faith, on Heaven's table land,
A higher plane than I have found;
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I want to scale the utmost height
And catch a gleam of glory bright;
But still I'll pray till Heav'n I've found,
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Lord, lift me up and let me stand,
By faith, on Heaven's table land,
A higher plane than I have found;
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning
Our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy, holy, holy! All the saints adore Thee,
Casting down their golden crowns
Around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and seraphim falling down before Thee,
Who was, and is, and evermore shall be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy, holy, holy! though the darkness hide Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man
Thy glory may not see;
Only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee,
Perfect in power, in love, and purity.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
All Thy works shall praise Thy name,
In earth, and sky, and sea;
Holy, holy, holy; merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I am Thine, O Lord, I have heard Thy voice,
And it told Thy love to me;
But I long to rise in the arms of faith
And be closer drawn to Thee.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died.
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Consecrate me now to Thy service, Lord,
By the power of grace divine;
Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope,
And my will be lost in Thine.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died.
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O the pure delight of a single hour
That before Thy throne I spend,
When I kneel in prayer, and with Thee, my God
I commune as friend with friend!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died.
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There are depths of love that I cannot know
Till I cross the narrow sea;
There are heights of joy that I may not reach
Till I rest in peace with Thee.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died.
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

songs.title: I Heard the Voice of Jesus Say
songs.author: Horatius Bonar (1808–1889)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say,
Come unto Me and rest;
Lay down, thou weary one, lay down
Thy head upon My breast.
I came to Jesus as I was,
Weary and worn and sad;
I found in Him a resting place,
And He has made me glad.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say,
Behold, I freely give
The living water; thirsty one,
Stoop down, and drink, and live.
I came to Jesus, and I drank
Of that life giving stream;
My thirst was quenched, my soul revived,
And now I live in Him.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say,
I am this dark world's light;
Look unto Me, thy morn shall rise,
And all thy day be bright.
I looked to Jesus, and I found
In Him my star, my sun;
And in that light of life I'll walk,
Till travelling days are done.

songs.title: I Know Whom I Have Believed
songs.author: Daniel W. Whittle (1840–1901)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I know not why God's wondrous grace
To me He hath made known,
Nor why, unworthy, Christ in love
Redeemed me for His own.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: But I know whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I know not how this saving faith
To me He did impart,
Nor how believing in His Word
Wrought peace within my heart.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: But I know whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I know not how the Spirit moves,
Convincing us of sin,
Revealing Jesus through the Word,
Creating faith in Him.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: But I know whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I know not what of good or ill
May be reserved for me,
Of weary ways or golden days,
Before His face I see.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: But I know whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: I know not when my Lord may come,
At night or noonday fair,
Nor if I walk the vale with Him,
Or meet Him in the air.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: But I know whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day.

songs.title: I Love to Tell the Story
songs.author: A. Katherine Hankey (1834–1911)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I love to tell the story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
I love to tell the story,
Because I know 'tis true;
It satisfies my longings
As nothing else can do.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I love to tell the story;
More wonderful it seems
Than all the golden fancies
Of all our golden dreams.
I love to tell the story,
It did so much for me;
And that is just the reason
I tell it now to thee.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I love to tell the story;
'Tis pleasant to repeat
What seems, each time I tell it,
More wonderfully sweet.
I love to tell the story,
For some have never heard
The message of salvation
From God's own holy Word.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I love to tell the story,
For those who know it best
Seem hungering and thirsting
To hear it like the rest.
And when, in scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song,
'Twill be the old, old story
That I have loved so long.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I must tell Jesus all of my trials;
I cannot bear these burdens alone;
In my distress He kindly will help me;
He ever loves and cares for His own.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
I cannot bear my burdens alone;
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I must tell Jesus all of my troubles;
He is a kind, compassionate friend;
If I but ask Him, He will deliver,
Make of my troubles quickly an end.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
I cannot bear my burdens alone;
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Tempted and tried, I need a great Saviour;
One who can help my burdens to bear;
I must tell Jesus, I must tell Jesus;
He all my cares and sorrows will share.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
I cannot bear my burdens alone;
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O how the world to evil allures me!
O how my heart is tempted to sin!
I must tell Jesus, and He will help me
Over the world the victory to win.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
I cannot bear my burdens alone;
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

songs.title: I Need Thee Every Hour
songs.author: Annie S. Hawks (1835–1918); refrain Robert Lowry (1826–1899)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I need Thee every hour,
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like Thine
Can peace afford.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I need Thee, O I need Thee;
Every hour I need Thee;
O bless me now, my Saviour,
I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I need Thee every hour,
Stay Thou nearby;
Temptations lose their power
When Thou art nigh.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I need Thee, O I need Thee;
Every hour I need Thee;
O bless me now, my Saviour,
I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I need Thee every hour,
In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide,
Or life is vain.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I need Thee, O I need Thee;
Every hour I need Thee;
O bless me now, my Saviour,
I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I need Thee every hour;
Teach me Thy will;
And Thy rich promises
In me fulfill.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I need Thee, O I need Thee;
Every hour I need Thee;
O bless me now, my Saviour,
I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: I need Thee every hour,
Most Holy One;
O make me Thine indeed,
Thou blessed Son.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I need Thee, O I need Thee;
Every hour I need Thee;
O bless me now, my Saviour,
I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All to Jesus, I surrender;
All to Him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust Him,
In His presence daily live.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All to Jesus I surrender;
Humbly at His feet I bow,
Worldly pleasures all forsaken;
Take me, Jesus, take me now.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All to Jesus, I surrender;
Make me, Saviour, wholly Thine;
Let me feel the Holy Spirit,
Truly know that Thou art mine.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All to Jesus, I surrender;
Lord, I give myself to Thee;
Fill me with Thy love and power;
Let Thy blessing fall on me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: All to Jesus I surrender;
Now I feel the sacred flame.
O the joy of full salvation!
Glory, glory, to His name!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Immortal, invisible, God only wise,
In light inaccessible, hid from our eyes,
Most blessed, most glorious, the Ancient of Days,
Almighty, victorious,
Thy great name we praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light,
Nor striving, nor wasting, Thou rulest in might;
Thy justice, like mountains, high soaring above
Thy clouds, which are fountains
Of mercy and love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To all life Thou givest, to both great and small;
In all life Thou livest, the true life of all;
We blossom and flourish as leaves on the tree,
To wither and perish—
But naught changeth Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All laud we would render; O help us to see,
'Tis only the splendour of light hideth Thee;
And now let Thy glory to our gaze unroll,
Through Christ in the story,
And Christ in the soul.

songs.title: In the Sweet By and By
songs.author: Sanford F. Bennett (1836–1898)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar;
For the Father waits over the way
To prepare us a dwelling place there.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blessed;
And our spirits shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessing of rest.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To our bountiful Father above,
We will offer our tribute of praise
For the glorious gift of His love
And the blessings that hallow our days.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore.

songs.title: It Came upon the Midnight Clear
songs.author: Edmund H. Sears (1810–1876)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: It came upon the midnight clear,
That glorious song of old,
From angels bending near the earth,
To touch their harps of gold;
Peace on the earth, good will to men,
From Heaven's all gracious king.
The world in solemn stillness lay,
To hear the angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Still through the cloven skies they come
With peaceful wings unfurled,
And still their heavenly music floats
O'er all the weary world;
Above its sad and lowly plains,
They bend on hovering wing,
And ever over its Babel sounds
The blessed angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yet with the woes of sin and strife
The world has suffered long;
Beneath the angel strain have rolled
Two thousand years of wrong;
And man, at war with man, hears not
The love-song which they bring;
O hush the noise, ye men of strife
And hear the angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And ye, beneath life's crushing load,
Whose forms are bending low,
Who toil along the climbing way
With painful steps and slow,
Look now! for glad and golden hours
Come swiftly on the wing.
O rest beside the weary road,
And hear the angels sing!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: For lo! the days are hastening on,
By prophet-bards foretold,
When with the ever circling years
Comes round the age of gold;
When peace shall over all the earth
Its ancient splendours fling,
And the whole world send back the song
Which now the angels sing.

songs.title: It Is Well with My Soul
songs.author: Horatio G. Spafford (1828–1888)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When peace, like a river, attendeth my way,
When sorrows like sea billows roll;
Whatever my lot, thou hast taught me to say,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though Satan should buffet, though trials should come,
Let this blest assurance control,
That Christ has regarded my helpless estate,
And hath shed His own blood for my soul.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My sin—oh, the bliss of this glorious thought—
My sin—not in part but the whole,
Is nailed to the cross, and I bear it no more,
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And Lord, haste the day when my faith shall be sight,
The clouds be rolled back as a scroll;
The trump shall resound, and the Lord shall descend,
Even so—it is well with my soul.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus calls us over the tumult
Of our life's wild, restless, sea;
Day by day His sweet voice soundeth,
Saying, Christian, follow Me!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As of old Saint Andrew heard it
By the Galilean lake,
Turned from home and toil and kindred,
Leaving all for Jesus' sake.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus calls us from the worship
Of the vain world's golden store,
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying, Christian, love Me more!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still He calls, in cares and pleasures,
Christian, love Me more than these!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Jesus calls us! By Thy mercies,
Saviour may we hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thine obedience,
Serve and love Thee best of all.

songs.title: Jesus Is All the World to Me
songs.author: Will L. Thompson (1847–1909)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus is all the world to me,
My life, my joy, my all;
He is my strength from day to day,
Without Him I would fall.
When I am sad, to Him I go,
No other one can cheer me so;
When I am sad, He makes me glad,
He's my friend.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus is all the world to me,
My friend in trials sore;
I go to Him for blessings, and
He gives them over and o'er.
He sends the sunshine and the rain,
He sends the harvest's golden grain;
Sunshine and rain, harvest of grain,
He's my friend.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus is all the world to me,
And true to Him I'll be;
O how could I this friend deny,
When He's so true to me?
Following Him I know I'm right,
He watches o'er me day and night;
Following Him by day and night,
He's my friend.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus is all the world to me,
I want no better friend;
I trust Him now, I'll trust Him when
Life's fleeting days shall end.
Beautiful life with such a friend,
Beautiful life that has no end;
Eternal life, eternal joy,
He's my friend.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus loves me—this I know,
For the Bible tells me so;
Little ones to Him belong—
They are weak, but He is strong.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus loves me—He who died
Heaven's gate to open wide;
He will wash away my sin,
Let His little child come in.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus loves me—loves me still,
Though I'm very weak and ill;
From His shining throne on high
Comes to watch me where I lie.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus loves me—He will stay
Close beside me all the way,
Then His little child will take
Up to Heaven for His dear sake.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I hear the Saviour say,
Thy strength indeed is small;
Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For nothing good have I
Whereby Thy grace to claim,
I'll wash my garments white
In the blood of Calv'ry's Lamb.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, now indeed I find
Thy power and Thine alone,
Can change the leper's spots
And melt the heart of stone.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when before the throne
I stand in Him complete,
I'll lay my trophies down
All down at Jesus' feet.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
Does his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till moons shall wax and wane no more.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: To Him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown His head;
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song;
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their early blessings on His name.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Blessings abound where'er He reigns;
The prisoner leaps to lose his chains;
The weary find eternal rest,
And all the sons of want are blest.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Let every creature rise and bring
Peculiar honours to our king;
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth repeat the loud amen.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.
Thou hast bid me gaze upon Thee,
And Thy beauty fills my soul,
For by Thy transforming power,
Thou hast made me whole.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O, how great Thy loving kindness,
Vaster, broader than the sea!
O, how marvelous Thy goodness,
Lavished all on me!
Yes, I rest in Thee, Beloved,
Know what wealth of grace is Thine,
Know Thy certainty of promise,
And have made it mine.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Simply trusting Thee, Lord Jesus,
I behold Thee as Thou art,
And Thy love, so pure, so changeless,
Satisfies my heart;
Satisfies its deepest longings,
Meets, supplies its every need,
Compasseth me round with blessings:
Thine is love indeed!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ever lift Thy face upon me
As I work and wait for Thee;
Resting 'neath Thy smile, Lord Jesus,
Earth's dark shadows flee.
Brightness of my Father's glory,
Sunshine of my Father's face,
Keep me ever trusting, resting,
Fill me with Thy grace.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.

songs.title: Jesus, Keep Me Near the Cross
songs.author: Fanny Crosby (1820–1915)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, keep me near the cross,
There a precious fountain
Free to all, a healing stream
Flows from Calvary's mountain.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the bright and morning star
Sheds its beams around me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Near the cross! O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day,
With its shadows o'er me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Near the cross I'll watch and wait
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand,
Just beyond the river.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high.
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide,
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide;
O receive my soul at last.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Other refuge have I none,
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah! leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenseless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou, O Christ, art all I want,
More than all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy name,
I am all unrighteousness;
False and full of sin I am;
Thou art full of truth and grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Plenteous grace with Thee is found,
Grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound;
Make and keep me pure within.
Thou of life the fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart;
Rise to all eternity.

songs.title: Jesus, the Very Thought of Thee
songs.author: Latin, 12th century; tr. Edward Caswall (1814–1878)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, the very thought of Thee
With sweetness fills the breast;
But sweeter far Thy face to see,
And in Thy presence rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Nor voice can sing, nor heart can frame,
Nor can the memory find
A sweeter sound than Thy blest name,
O Saviour of mankind!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O hope of every contrite heart,
O joy of all the meek,
To those who fall, how kind Thou art!
How good to those who seek!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: But what to those who find? Ah, this
Nor tongue nor pen can show;
The love of Jesus, what it is,
None but His loved ones know.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Jesus, our only joy be Thou,
As Thou our prize will be;
Jesus be Thou our glory now,
And through eternity.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Joy to the world; the Lord is come;
Let earth receive her king:
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And Heaven and nature sing,
And Heaven and nature sing,
And Heaven, and Heaven, and nature sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Joy to the earth, the Saviour reigns;
Let men their songs employ;
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat, the sounding joy.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: No more let sins and sorrows grow,
Nor thorns infest the ground;
He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found,
Far as the curse is found,
Far as, far as, the curse is found.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove
The glories of His righteousness,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders, wonders, of His love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Just as I am—without one plea,
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bidst me come to Thee—
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Just as I am—and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To Thee whose blood can cleanse each spot—
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Just as I am—though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt,
Fightings and fears within, without—
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Just as I am—poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need in Thee to find—
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Just as I am—Thou wilt receive,
Wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve;
Because Thy promise I believe—
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Just as I am—Thy love unknown
Hath broken every barrier down;
Now, to be Thine, yea, Thine alone—
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

songs.title: Lead Us, Heavenly Father, Lead Us
songs.author: James Edmeston (1791–1867)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lead us, heav'nly Father, lead us
O'er the world's tempestuous sea;
Guard us, guide us, keep us, feed us,
For we have no help but Thee;
Yet possessing every blessing
If our God our Father be.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Saviour, breathe forgiveness o'er us;
All our weakness Thou dost know;
Thou didst tread this earth before us,
Thou didst feel its keenest woe;
Lone and dreary, faint and weary,
Through the desert Thou didst go.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Spirit of our God, descending,
Fill our hearts with heav'nly joy,
Love with every passion blending,
Pleasure that can never cloy;
Thus provided, pardoned, guided,
Nothing can our peace destroy.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lead, kindly Light, amid th'encircling gloom,
Lead Thou me on!
The night is dark, and I am far from home;
Lead Thou me on!
Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see
The distant scene; one step enough for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I was not ever thus, nor prayed that Thou
Shouldst lead me on;
I loved to choose and see my path; but now
Lead Thou me on!
I loved the garish day, and, spite of fears,
Pride ruled my will. Remember not past years!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So long Thy power hath blest me, sure it still
Will lead me on.
O'er moor and fen, o'er crag and torrent,
Till the night is gone,
And with the morn those angel faces smile, which I
Have loved long since, and lost awhile!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What a fellowship, what a joy divine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
What a blessedness,
What a peace is mine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
O how bright the path
Grows from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What have I to dread? What have I to fear?
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
I have blessed peace
With my Lord so near,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

songs.title: Lo, He Comes with Clouds Descending
songs.author: John Cennick (1718–1755); Charles Wesley (1707–1788); Martin Madan (1725–1790)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lo! He comes with clouds descending,
Once for favoured sinners slain;
Thousand, thousand saints attending,
Swell the triumph of His train:
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
God appears on earth to reign.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Every eye shall now behold Him
Robed in dreadful majesty;
Those who set at naught and sold Him,
Pierced and nailed Him to the tree,
Deeply wailing, deeply wailing, deeply wailing,
Shall the true Messiah see.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The dear tokens of His passion
Still His dazzling body bears;
Cause of endless exultation
To His ransomed worshippers;
With what rapture, with what rapture,
With what rapture
Gaze we on those glorious scars!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yea, Amen! let all adore Thee,
High on Thine eternal throne;
Saviour, take the power and glory,
Claim the kingdom for Thine own;
O come quickly! O come quickly!
O come quickly!
Everlasting God, come down!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Love divine, all loves excelling,
Joy of Heav'n to earth come down;
Fix in us thy humble dwelling;
All thy faithful mercies crown!
Jesus, Thou art all compassion,
Pure unbounded love Thou art;
Visit us with Thy salvation;
Enter every trembling heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe, O breathe Thy loving Spirit,
Into every troubled breast!
Let us all in Thee inherit;
Let us find that second rest.
Take away our bent to sinning;
Alpha and Omega be;
End of faith, as its beginning,
Set our hearts at liberty.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, Almighty to deliver,
Let us all Thy life receive;
Suddenly return and never,
Never more Thy temples leave.
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above,
Pray and praise Thee without ceasing,
Glory in Thy perfect love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Finish, then, Thy new creation;
Pure and spotless let us be.
Let us see Thy great salvation
Perfectly restored in Thee;
Changed from glory into glory,
Till in Heav'n we take our place,
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love, and praise.

songs.title: Low in the Grave He Lay
songs.author: Robert Lowry (1826–1899)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Low in the grave He lay, Jesus my Saviour,
Waiting the coming day, Jesus my Lord!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes,
He arose a victor from the dark domain,
And He lives forever, with His saints to reign.
He arose! He arose!
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Vainly they watch His bed, Jesus my Saviour;
Vainly they seal the dead, Jesus my Lord!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes,
He arose a victor from the dark domain,
And He lives forever, with His saints to reign.
He arose! He arose!
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Death cannot keep its prey, Jesus my Saviour;
He tore the bars away, Jesus my Lord!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes,
He arose a victor from the dark domain,
And He lives forever, with His saints to reign.
He arose! He arose!
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

songs.title: My Faith Looks Up to Thee
songs.author: Ray Palmer (1808–1887)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My faith looks up to Thee,
Thou Lamb of Calvary, Saviour divine!
Now hear me while I pray, take all my guilt away,
O let me from this day be wholly Thine!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May Thy rich grace impart
Strength to my fainting heart, my zeal inspire!
As Thou hast died for me, O may my love to Thee,
Pure warm, and changeless be, a living fire!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: While life's dark maze I tread,
And griefs around me spread, be Thou my guide;
Bid darkness turn to day, wipe sorrow's tears away,
Nor let me ever stray from Thee aside.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When ends life's transient dream,
When death's cold sullen stream shall o'er me roll;
Blest Saviour, then in love, fear and distrust remove;
O bear me safe above, a ransomed soul!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!
E'en though it be a cross
That raiseth me,
Still all my song would be,

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though like the wanderer,
The sun gone down,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone;
Yet in my dreams I'd be,

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There let the way appear,
Steps unto Heav'n;
All that Thou sendest me,
In mercy giv'n;
Angels to beckon me

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then, with my waking thoughts,
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs,
Bethel I'll raise;
So by my woes to be,

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Or, if on joyful wing
Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon, and stars forgot,
Upward I'll fly,
Still all my song shall be,

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For my pardon, this I see,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
For my cleansing this my plea,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Nothing can for sin atone,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Naught of good that I have done,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: This is all my hope and peace,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
This is all my righteousness,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Now by this I'll overcome—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus,
Now by this I'll reach my home—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

songs.title: Now Thank We All Our God
songs.author: Martin Rinkart (1586–1649); tr. Catherine Winkworth (1827–1878)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now thank we all our God,
With heart and hands and voices,
Who wondrous things has done,
In whom this world rejoices;
Who from our mothers' arms
Has blessed us on our way
With countless gifts of love,
And still is ours today.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O may this bounteous God
Through all our life be near us,
With ever joyful hearts
And blessed peace to cheer us;
And keep us in His grace,
And guide us when perplexed;
And free us from all ills,
In this world and the next!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given;
The Son and Him who reigns
With Them in highest Heaven;
The one eternal God,
Whom earth and Heaven adore;
For thus it was, is now,
And shall be evermore.

songs.title: O Come, All Ye Faithful
songs.author: John F. Wade (1711–1786); tr. Frederick Oakeley (1802–1880)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O come, all ye faithful,
Joyful and triumphant,
O come ye, O come ye,
To Bethlehem.
Come and behold Him,
Born the King of angels;

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: True God of true God
Light from Light Eternal,
Lo, He shuns not
The virgin's womb;
Son of the Father,
Begotten, not created;

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sing, choirs of angels,
Sing in exultation;
O sing, all ye citizens
Of Heaven above!
Glory to God, all
Glory in the highest;

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yea, Lord, we greet Thee,
Born this happy morning;
Jesus, to Thee be all glory given;
Word of the Father,
Now in flesh appearing.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord.

songs.title: O for a Thousand Tongues to Sing
songs.author: Charles Wesley (1707–1788)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O for a thousand tongues to sing
My great Redeemer's praise,
The glories of my God and king,
The triumphs of His grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My gracious master and my God,
Assist me to proclaim,
To spread through all the earth abroad
The honours of Thy name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus! the name that charms our fears,
That bids our sorrows cease;
'Tis music in the sinner's ears,
'Tis life, and health, and peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He breaks the power of canceled sin,
He sets the prisoner free;
His blood can make the foulest clean,
His blood availed for me.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: He speaks, and, listening to His voice,
New life the dead receive,
The mournful, broken hearts rejoice,
The humble poor believe.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Hear Him, ye deaf; His praise, ye dumb,
Your loosened tongues employ;
Ye blind, behold your Saviour come,
And leap, ye lame, for joy.

songs.title: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
songs.author: Isaac Watts (1674–1748)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Our God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
