Our shelter from the stormy blast,
And our eternal home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Under the shadow of Thy throne
Thy saints have dwelt secure;
Sufficient is Thine arm alone,
And our defense is sure.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Before the hills in order stood,
Or earth received her frame,
From everlasting Thou art God,
To endless years the same.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: A thousand ages in Thy sight
Are like an evening gone;
Short as the watch that ends the night
Before the rising sun.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Time, like an ever rolling stream,
Bears all its sons away;
They fly, forgotten, as a dream
Dies at the opening day.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Our God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Be Thou our guard while troubles last,
And our eternal home.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
Be Thou forever near me,
My master and my friend;
I shall not fear the battle
If Thou art by my side,
Nor wander from the pathway
If Thou wilt be my guide.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O let me feel Thee near me!
The world is ever near;
I see the sights that dazzle,
The tempting sounds I hear;
My foes are ever near me,
Around me and within;
But Jesus, draw Thou nearer,
And shield my soul from sin.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O let me hear Thee speaking
In accents clear and still,
Above the storms of passion,
The murmurs of self will.
O speak to reassure me,
To hasten or control;
O speak, and make me listen,
Thou guardian of my soul.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Jesus, Thou hast promised
To all who follow Thee
That where Thou art in glory
There shall Thy servant be.
And Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
O give me grace to follow,
My master and my friend.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O let me see Thy footprints,
And in them plant mine own;
My hope to follow duly
Is in Thy strength alone.
O guide me, call me, draw me,
Uphold me to the end;
And then in Heav'n receive me,
My Saviour and my friend.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O little town of Bethlehem,
How still we see thee lie!
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep
The silent stars go by.
Yet in thy dark streets shineth
The everlasting Light;
The hopes and fears of all the years
Are met in thee tonight.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For Christ is born of Mary,
And gathered all above,
While mortals sleep, the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.
O morning stars together,
Proclaim the holy birth,
And praises sing to God the King,
And peace to men on earth!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How silently, how silently,
The wondrous Gift is giv'n;
So God imparts to human hearts
The blessings of His Heav'n.
No ear may hear His coming,
But in this world of sin,
Where meek souls will receive Him still,
The dear Christ enters in.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O holy Child of Bethlehem,
Descend to us, we pray;
Cast out our sin, and enter in,
Be born in us today.
We hear the Christmas angels
The great glad tidings tell;
O come to us, abide with us,
Our Lord Emmanuel!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Oh worship the King, all glorious above!
O gratefully sing His power and His love—
Our shield and defender, the Ancient of Days,
Pavilioned in splendour, and girded with praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh tell of His might! O sing of His grace!
Whose robe is the light, whose canopy space;
His chariots of wrath the deep thunderclouds form,
And dark is His path on the wings of the storm.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The earth, with its store of wonders untold,
Almighty! Thy power hath founded of old;
Established it fast by a changeless decree,
And round it hath cast, like a mantle, the sea.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thy bountiful care, what tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air, it shines in the light;
It streams from the hills, it descends to the plain,
And sweetly distills in the dew and the rain.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Frail children of dust, and feeble as frail,
In Thee do we trust, nor find Thee to fail;
Thy mercies how tender! How firm to the end!
Our maker, defender, redeemer, and friend!

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: O measureless might! Ineffable love!
While angels delight to worship Thee above,
The humbler creation, though feeble their lays,
With true adoration shall all sing Thy praise.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Once in royal David's city
Stood a lowly cattle shed,
Where a mother laid her baby
In a manger for His bed:
Mary was that mother mild,
Jesus Christ her little child.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He came down to earth from Heaven,
Who is God and Lord of all,
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall;
With the poor, and mean, and lowly,
Lived on earth our Saviour holy.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And, through all His wondrous childhood,
He would honour and obey,
Love and watch the lowly maiden,
In whose gentle arms He lay:
Christian children all must be
Mild, obedient, good as He.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For He is our childhood's pattern;
Day by day, like us He grew;
He was little, weak and helpless,
Tears and smiles like us He knew;
And He feeleth for our sadness,
And He shareth in our gladness.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: And our eyes at last shall see Him,
Through His own redeeming love,
For that Child so dear and gentle
Is our Lord in Heav'n above,
And He leads His children on
To the place where He is gone.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Not in that poor lowly stable,
With the oxen standing by,
We shall see Him; but in Heaven,
Set at God's right hand on high;
Where like stars His children crowned
All in white shall wait around.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.
Christ, the royal Master,
Leads against the foe;
Forward into battle
See His banners go!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: At the sign of triumph,
Satan's host doth flee;
On then, Christian soldiers,
On to victory!
Hell's foundations quiver
At the shout of praise;
Brothers, lift your voices,
Loud your anthems raise.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Like a mighty army
Moves the Church of God;
Brothers, we are treading
Where the saints have trod.
We are not divided,
All one body we,
One in hope, in doctrine,
One in charity.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Crowns and thrones may perish,
Kingdoms rise and wane,
But the Church of Jesus
Constant will remain.
Gates of hell can never
'Gainst that church prevail;
We have Christ's own promise,
And that cannot fail.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Onward then, ye people,
Join our happy throng,
Blend with ours your voices
In the triumph song.
Glory, laud and honour
Unto Christ the King,
This through countless ages
Men and angels sing.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.

songs.title: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Saviour
songs.author: Fanny Crosby (1820–1915)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Pass me not, O gentle Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Saviour, Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let me at Thy throne of mercy
Find a sweet relief,
Kneeling there in deep contrition;
Help my unbelief.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Saviour, Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Trusting only in Thy merit,
Would I seek Thy face;
Heal my wounded, broken spirit,
Save me by Thy grace.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Saviour, Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thou the Spring of all my comfort,
More than life to me,
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
Whom in Heav'n but Thee?

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Saviour, Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise Him, praise Him—
Jesus, our blessed Redeemer,
Sing, O earth, His wonderful love proclaim.
Hail Him! hail Him! highest archangels in glory;
Strength and honour give to His holy name!
Like a shepherd, Jesus will guard His children,
In His arms He carries them all day long:
O ye saints that dwell on the mountain of Zion,
Praise Him, praise Him ever in joyful song.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise Him, praise Him—
Jesus, our blessed Redeemer,
For our sins He suffered, and bled, and died;
He our rock, our hope of eternal salvation,
Hail Him, hail Him, Jesus the Crucified.
Loving Saviour, meekly enduring sorrow,
Crowned with thorns that cruelly pierced His brow;
Once for us rejected, despised and forsaken,
Prince of Glory, He is triumphant now.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise Him, praise Him—
Jesus, our blessed Redeemer,
Heav'nly portals loud with hosannas ring,
Jesus, Saviour, reigneth forever and ever.
Crown Him! Crown Him—
Prophet, and Priest, and King!
Death is vanquished! Tell it with joy, ye faithful.
Where is now thy victory, boasting grave?
Jesus lives! No longer thy portals are cheerless;
Jesus lives, the mighty and strong to save.

songs.title: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
songs.author: Joachim Neander (1650–1680); tr. Catherine Winkworth (1827–1878)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise to the Lord!
The Almighty, the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him,
For He is thy health and salvation!
All ye who hear,
Now to His temple draw near;
Join me in glad adoration.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise to the Lord!
Who o'er all things so wondrously reigneth,
Shelters thee under His wings,
Yea, so gently sustaineth;
Hast thou not seen
How thy desires have been
Granted in what He ordaineth?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise to the Lord,
Who hath fearfully, wondrously, made thee;
Health hath vouchsafed
And, when heedlessly falling, hath stayed thee.
What need or grief
Ever hath failed of relief?
Wings of His mercy did shade thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Praise to the Lord,
Who doth prosper thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness
And mercy here daily attend thee.
Ponder anew
What the Almighty can do,
If with His love He befriend thee!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Praise to the Lord,
O let all that is in me adore Him!
All that hath life and breath,
Come now with praises before Him!
Let the Amen
Sound from His people again,
Gladly for aye we adore Him!

songs.title: Praise, My Soul, the King of Heaven
songs.author: Henry F. Lyte (1793–1847)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise, my soul, the King of Heaven;
To His feet thy tribute bring!
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven,
Who like me His praise should sing?
Praise Him! praise Him!
Praise the everlasting King!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise Him for His grace and favour
To our fathers in distress!
Praise Him still the same for ever,
Slow to chide, and swift to bless!
Praise Him! praise Him!
Glorious in His faithfulness.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Fatherlike He tends and spares us;
Well our feeble frame He knows.
In His hands He gently bears us,
Rescues us from all our foes.
Praise Him! praise Him!
Widely as His mercy flows!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Angels, help us to adore Him;
Ye behold Him face to face:
Sun and moon, bow down before Him,
Dwellers all in time and space.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Praise with us the God of grace!

songs.title: Redeemed, How I Love to Proclaim It
songs.author: Fanny Crosby (1820–1915)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Redeemed, how I love to proclaim it!
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed through His infinite mercy,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Redeemed, redeemed,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed, redeemed,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Redeemed, and so happy in Jesus,
No language my rapture can tell;
I know that the light of His presence
With me doth continually dwell.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Redeemed, redeemed,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed, redeemed,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I think of my blessed Redeemer,
I think of Him all the day long:
I sing, for I cannot be silent;
His love is the theme of my song.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Redeemed, redeemed,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed, redeemed,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I know I shall see in His beauty
The King in whose law I delight;
Who lovingly guardeth my footsteps,
And giveth me songs in the night.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Redeemed, redeemed,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed, redeemed,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rejoice, the Lord is king!
Your Lord and king adore;
Mortals give thanks and sing,
And triumph evermore;
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus, the Saviour, reigns,
The God of truth and love;
When He had purged our stains
He took His seat above;
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His kingdom cannot fail,
He rules o'er earth and Heav'n,
The keys of death and hell
Are to our Jesus giv'n;
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He sits at God's right hand
Till all His foes submit,
And bow to His command,
And fall beneath His feet:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Rejoice in glorious hope!
Jesus the Judge shall come,
And take His servants up
To their eternal home.
We soon shall hear th'archangel's voice;
The trump of God shall sound, rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Snatch them in pity from sin and the grave;
Weep o'er the erring one, lift up the fallen,
Tell them of Jesus, the mighty to save.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though they are slighting Him, still He is waiting,
Waiting the penitent child to receive;
Plead with them earnestly, plead with them gently;
He will forgive if they only believe.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Down in the human heart, crushed by the tempter,
Feelings lie buried that grace can restore;
Touched by a loving heart, wakened by kindness,
Chords that were broken will vibrate once more.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Rescue the perishing, duty demands it;
Strength for thy labour the Lord will provide;
Back to the narrow way patiently win them;
Tell the poor wand'rer a Saviour has died.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We praise Thee, O God!
For the Son of Thy love,
For Jesus who died,
And is now gone above.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We praise Thee, O God!
For Thy Spirit of light,
Who hath shown us our Saviour,
And scattered our night.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All glory and praise
To the Lamb that was slain,
Who hath borne all our sins,
And hath cleansed every stain.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All glory and praise
To the God of all grace,
Who hast bought us, and sought us,
And guided our ways.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Revive us again;
Fill each heart with Thy love;
May each soul be rekindled
With fire from above.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure;
Save from wrath and make me pure.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not the labour of my hands
Can fulfill Thy law's demands;
Could my zeal no respite know,
Could my tears forever flow,
All for sin could not atone;
Thou must save, and Thou alone.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Nothing in my hand I bring,
Simply to the cross I cling;
Naked, come to Thee for dress;
Helpless look to Thee for grace;
Foul, I to the fountain fly;
Wash me, Saviour, or I die.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: While I draw this fleeting breath,
When mine eyes shall close in death,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
See Thee on Thy judgment throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

songs.title: Safe in the Arms of Jesus
songs.author: Fanny Crosby (1820–1915)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast,
There by His love o'ershaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.
Hark! 'tis the voice of angels,
Borne in a song to me.
Over the fields of glory,
Over the jasper sea.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast
There by His love o'ershaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe from corroding care,
Safe from the world's temptations,
Sin cannot harm me there.
Free from the blight of sorrow,
Free from my doubts and fears;
Only a few more trials,
Only a few more tears!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast
There by His love o'ershaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus, my heart's dear refuge,
Jesus has died for me;
Firm on the Rock of Ages,
Ever my trust shall be.
Here let me wait with patience,
Wait till the night is over;
Wait till I see the morning
Break on the golden shore.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast
There by His love o'ershaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.

songs.title: Saviour, Like a Shepherd Lead Us
songs.author: Attributed to Dorothy A. Thrupp (1779–1847)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Saviour, like a shepherd lead us,
Much we need Thy tender care;
In Thy pleasant pastures feed us,
For our use Thy folds prepare.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are Thine, Thou dost befriend us,
Be the guardian of our way;
Keep Thy flock, from sin defend us,
Seek us when we go astray.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!
Hear, O hear us when we pray.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!
Hear, O hear us when we pray.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou hast promised to receive us,
Poor and sinful though we be;
Thou hast mercy to relieve us,
Grace to cleanse and power to free.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!
We will early turn to Thee.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!
We will early turn to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Early let us seek Thy favour,
Early let us do Thy will;
Blessed Lord and only Saviour,
With Thy love our bosoms fill.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!
Thou hast loved us, love us still.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!
Thou hast loved us, love us still.

songs.title: Shall We Gather at the River
songs.author: Robert Lowry (1826–1899)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Shall we gather at the river,
Where bright angel feet have trod,
With its crystal tide forever
Flowing by the throne of God?

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On the margin of the river,
Washing up its silver spray,
We will talk and worship ever,
All the happy golden day.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ere we reach the shining river,
Lay we every burden down;
Grace our spirits will deliver,
And provide a robe and crown.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Soon we'll reach the silver river,
Soon our pilgrimage will cease;
Soon our happy hearts will quiver
With the melody of peace.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

songs.title: Silent Night
songs.author: Joseph Mohr (1792–1848); tr. John F. Young (1820–1885)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Silent night, holy night,
All is calm, all is bright
Round yon virgin mother and Child.
Holy Infant, so tender and mild,
Sleep in heavenly peace,
Sleep in heavenly peace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Silent night, holy night,
Shepherds quake at the sight;
Glories stream from heaven afar,
Heavenly hosts sing Alleluia!
Christ the Saviour is born,
Christ the Saviour is born!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Silent night, holy night,
Son of God, love's pure light;
Radiant beams from Thy holy face
With the dawn of redeeming grace,
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth,
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth.

songs.title: Since Jesus Came into My Heart
songs.author: Rufus H. McDaniel (1850–1940)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What a wonderful change
In my life has been wrought
Since Jesus came into my heart!
I have light in my soul
For which long I had sought,
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I have ceased from my wandering
And going astray,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And my sins, which were many,
Are all washed away,
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I'm possessed of a hope
That is steadfast and sure,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And no dark clouds of doubt
Now my pathway obscure,
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There's a light in the valley
Of death now for me,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And the gates of the city
Beyond I can see,
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling for you and for me;
See, on the portals He's waiting and watching,
Watching for you and for me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Why should we tarry when Jesus is pleading,
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not His mercies,
Mercies for you and for me?

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Time is now fleeting, the moments are passing,
Passing from you and from me;
Shadows are gathering, deathbeds are coming,
Coming for you and for me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O for the wonderful love He has promised,
Promised for you and for me!
Though we have sinned,
He has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Soldiers of Christ, arise,
And put your armour on,
Strong in the strength which God supplies
Through His eternal Son.
Strong in the Lord of hosts,
And in His mighty power,
Who in the strength of Jesus trusts
Is more than conqueror.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Stand then in His great might,
With all His strength endued,
And take, to arm you for the fight,
The panoply of God;
That, having all things done,
And all your conflicts past,
Ye may o'ercome through Christ alone
And stand entire at last.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Stand then against your foes,
In close and firm array;
Legions of wily fiends oppose
Throughout the evil day;
But meet the sons of night,
And mock their vain design,
Armed in the arms of heavenly light,
Of righteousness divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Leave no unguarded place,
No weakness of the soul,
Take every virtue, every grace,
And fortify the whole;
Indissolubly joined,
To battle all proceed;
But arm yourselves with all the mind
That was in Christ, your head.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: From strength to strength go on,
Wrestle, and fight, and pray,
Tread all the powers of darkness down,
And win the well-fought day;
Still let the Spirit cry
In all His soldiers, Come!
Till Christ the Lord descends from high
And takes the conquerors home.

songs.title: Stand Up, Stand Up for Jesus
songs.author: George Duffield Jr. (1818–1888)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
Ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner,
It must not suffer loss.
From victory unto victory
His army shall He lead,
Till every foe is vanquished,
And Christ is Lord indeed.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
The solemn watchword hear;
If while ye sleep He suffers,
Away with shame and fear;
Where'er ye meet with evil,
Within you or without,
Charge for the God of battles,
And put the foe to rout.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
The trumpet call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict,
In this His glorious day.
Ye that are brave now serve Him
Against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger,
And strength to strength oppose.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
Stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you,
Ye dare not trust your own.
Put on the Gospel armour,
Each piece put on with prayer;
Where duty calls or danger,
Be never wanting there.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Standing on the promises of Christ my king,
Through eternal ages let His praises ring,
Glory in the highest, I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living Word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Standing on the promises I now can see
Perfect, present cleansing in the blood for me;
Standing in the liberty where Christ makes free,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Standing on the promises I cannot fall,
Listening every moment to the Spirit's call
Resting in my Saviour as my all in all,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
That calls me from a world of care,
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my wants and wishes known.
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief
And oft escaped the tempter's snare
By thy return, sweet hour of prayer!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
The joys I feel, the bliss I share,
Of those whose anxious spirits burn
With strong desires for thy return!
With such I hasten to the place
Where God my Saviour shows His face,
And gladly take my station there,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His Word and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!

songs.title: Take My Life and Let It Be
songs.author: Frances R. Havergal (1836–1879)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take my life, and let it be
Consecrated, Lord, to Thee.
Take my moments and my days;
Let them flow in ceaseless praise.
Take my hands, and let them move
At the impulse of Thy love.
Take my feet, and let them be
Swift and beautiful for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take my voice, and let me sing
Always, only, for my king.
Take my lips, and let them be
Filled with messages from Thee.
Take my silver and my gold;
Not a mite would I withhold.
Take my intellect, and use
Every power as Thou shalt choose.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Take my will, and make it Thine;
It shall be no longer mine.
Take my heart, it is Thine own;
It shall be Thy royal throne.
Take my love, my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure store.
Take myself, and I will be
Ever, only, all for Thee.

songs.title: Tell Me the Old, Old Story
songs.author: A. Katherine Hankey (1834–1911)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Tell me the old, old story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
Tell me the story simply,
As to a little child,
For I am weak and weary,
And helpless and defiled.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Tell me the story slowly,
That I may take it in,
That wonderful redemption,
God's remedy for sin.
Tell me the story often,
For I forget so soon;
The early dew of morning
Has passed away at noon.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Tell me the story softly,
With earnest tones and grave;
Remember I'm the sinner
Whom Jesus came to save.
Tell me the story always,
If you would really be,
In any time of trouble,
A comforter to me.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Tell me the same old story
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear.
Yes, and when that world's glory
Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story:
Christ Jesus makes thee whole.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Church's one foundation
Is Jesus Christ her Lord,
She is His new creation
By water and the Word:
From Heav'n He came and sought her
To be His holy bride,
With His own blood He bought her
And for her life He died.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: She is from every nation,
Yet one o'er all the earth;
Her charter of salvation,
One Lord, one faith, one birth;
One holy name she blesses,
Partakes one holy food,
And to one hope she presses,
With every grace endued.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though with a scornful wonder
Men see her sore oppressed,
By schisms rent asunder,
By heresies distressed:
Yet saints their watch are keeping,
Their cry goes up, How long?
And soon the night of weeping
Shall be the morn of song!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'Mid toil and tribulation,
And tumult of her war,
She waits the consummation
Of peace forevermore;
Till, with the vision glorious,
Her longing eyes are blest,
And the great Church victorious
Shall be the Church at rest!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Yet she on earth hath union
With God the Three in One,
And mystic sweet communion
With those whose rest is won,
With all her sons and daughters
Who, by the Master's hand
Led through the deathly waters,
Repose in Eden land.

songs.title: The Day Thou Gavest, Lord, Is Ended
songs.author: John Ellerton (1826–1893)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended,
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We thank Thee that Thy church, unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As o'er each continent and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The sun that bids us rest is waking
Our brethren 'neath the western sky,
And hour by hour fresh lips are making
Thy wondrous doings heard on high.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: So be it, Lord; Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away:
Thy kingdom stands, and grows forever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The first Noel the angel did say
Was to certain poor shepherds
In fields as they lay;
In fields where they lay tending their sheep,
On a cold winter's night that was so deep.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: They looked up and saw a star
Shining in the east, beyond them far;
And to the earth it gave great light,
And so it continued both day and night.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And by the light of that same star
Three wise men came from country far;
To seek for a king was their intent,
And to follow the star wherever it went.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: This star drew nigh to the northwest,
Over Bethlehem it took its rest;
And there it did both stop and stay,
Right over the place where Jesus lay.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Then entered in those wise men three,
Full reverently upon the knee,
And offered there, in His presence,
Their gold and myrrh and frankincense.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Then let us all with one accord
Sing praises to our heav'nly Lord;
That hath made Heav'n and earth of naught,
And with His blood mankind hath bought.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

songs.title: The King of Love My Shepherd Is
songs.author: Henry W. Baker (1821–1877)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The King of love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never,
I nothing lack if I am His
And He is mine forever.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Where streams of living water flow
My ransomed soul He leadeth,
And where the verdant pastures grow,
With food celestial feedeth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Perverse and foolish oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home, rejoicing, brought me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In death's dark vale I fear no ill
With Thee, dear Lord, beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still,
Thy cross before to guide me.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thou spread'st a table in my sight;
Thy unction grace bestoweth;
And O what transport of delight
From Thy pure chalice floweth!

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: And so through all the length of days
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise
Within Thy house forever.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord's my shepherd, I'll not want.
He makes me down to lie
In pastures green; He leadeth me
The quiet waters by.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My soul He doth restore again;
And me to walk doth make
Within the paths of righteousness,
Even for His own name's sake.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yea, though I walk in death's dark vale,
Yet will I fear no ill;
For Thou art with me; and Thy rod
And staff my comfort still.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My table Thou hast furnished
In presence of my foes;
My head Thou dost with oil anoint,
And my cup overflows.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Goodness and mercy all my life
Shall surely follow me;
And in God's house forevermore
My dwelling place shall be.

songs.title: The Solid Rock (My Hope Is Built)
songs.author: Edward Mote (1797–1874)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My hope is built on nothing less
Than Jesus' blood and righteousness.
'Midst all the hell I feel within,
On His completed work I lean.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: On Christ the solid rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When darkness veils His lovely face,
I rest upon unchanging grace.
In every rough and stormy gale,
My anchor holds within the veil.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: On Christ the solid rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His oath, His cov'nant, and His blood,
Support me in the sinking flood.
When all around my soul gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: On Christ the solid rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When I shall launch in worlds unseen,
Oh may I then be found in Him.
Dressed in His righteousness alone,
Faultless to stand before the throne.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: On Christ the solid rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a fountain filled with blood
Drawn from Emmanuel's veins;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains.
Lose all their guilty stains,
Lose all their guilty stains;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in his day;
And there have I, though vile as he,
Washed all my sins away.
Washed all my sins away,
Washed all my sins away;
And there have I, though vile as he,
Washed all my sins away.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Dear dying Lamb, Thy precious blood
Shall never lose its power
Till all the ransomed church of God
Be saved, to sin no more.
Be saved, to sin no more,
Be saved, to sin no more;
Till all the ransomed church of God
Be saved, to sin no more.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: E'er since, by faith, I saw the stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die.
And shall be till I die,
And shall be till I die;
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Then in a nobler, sweeter song,
I'll sing Thy power to save,
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue
Lies silent in the grave.
Lies silent in the grave,
Lies silent in the grave;
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue
Lies silent in the grave.

songs.title: There Is a Green Hill Far Away
songs.author: Cecil F. Alexander (1818–1895)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a green hill far away,
Outside a city wall,
Where the dear Lord was crucified,
Who died to save us all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We may not know, we cannot tell,
What pains He had to bear;
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He died that we might be forgiv'n,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to Heav'n,
Saved by His precious blood.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate
Of Heaven and let us in.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O dearly, dearly has He loved,
And we must love Him, too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.

songs.title: There Is Power in the Blood
songs.author: Lewis E. Jones (1865–1936)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Would you be free from the burden of sin?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Would you o'er evil a victory win?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: There is power, power, wonder working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Would you be free from your passion and pride?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Come for a cleansing to Calvary's tide;
There's wonderful power in the blood.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: There is power, power, wonder working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Would you be whiter, much whiter than snow?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Sin stains are lost in its life giving flow.
There's wonderful power in the blood.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: There is power, power, wonder working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Would you do service for Jesus your king?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Would you live daily His praises to sing?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: There is power, power, wonder working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.

songs.title: There Shall Be Showers of Blessing
songs.author: Daniel W. Whittle (1840–1901)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There shall be showers of blessing:
This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
Sent from the Saviour above.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need:
Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There shall be showers of blessing,
Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys,
Sound of abundance of rain.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need:
Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There shall be showers of blessing;
Send them upon us, O Lord;
Grant to us now a refreshing,
Come, and now honour Thy Word.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need:
Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There shall be showers of blessing:
Oh, that today they might fall,
Now as to God we're confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need:
Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: There shall be showers of blessing,
If we but trust and obey;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
If we let God have His way.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need:
Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

songs.title: Thine Be the Glory (Thine Is the Glory)
songs.author: Edmond L. Budry (1854–1932); tr. Richard B. Hoyle (1875–1939)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thine is the glory,
Risen, conqu'ring Son;
Endless is the victory,
Thou o'er death hast won;
Angels in bright raiment
Rolled the stone away,
Kept the folded grave clothes
Where Thy body lay.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Thine is the glory,
Risen, conquering Son,
Endless is the victory,
Thou o'er death hast won.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lo! Jesus meets us,
Risen from the tomb;
Lovingly He greets us,
Scatters fear and gloom;
Let the church with gladness,
Hymns of triumph sing;
For her Lord now liveth,
Death hath lost its sting.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Thine is the glory,
Risen, conquering Son,
Endless is the victory,
Thou o'er death hast won.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: No more we doubt Thee,
Glorious Prince of life;
Life is naught without Thee;
Aid us in our strife;
Make us more than conquerors,
Through Thy deathless love:
Bring us safe through Jordan
To Thy home above.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Thine is the glory,
Risen, conquering Son,
Endless is the victory,
Thou o'er death hast won.

songs.title: 'Tis So Sweet to Trust in Jesus
songs.author: Louisa M. R. Stead (1846–1917)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: 'Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus,
And to take Him at His word;
Just to rest upon His promise,
And to know, Thus says the Lord!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er;
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O how sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to trust His cleansing blood;
And in simple faith to plunge me
'Neath the healing, cleansing flood!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er;
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just from sin and self to cease;
Just from Jesus simply taking
Life and rest, and joy and peace.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er;
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I'm so glad I learned to trust Thee,
Precious Jesus, Saviour, friend;
And I know that Thou art with me,
Wilt be with me to the end.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er;
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To God be the glory,
Great things He has done;
So loved He the world
That He gave us His Son,
Who yielded His life
An atonement for sin,
And opened the life gate
That all may go in.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father,
Through Jesus the Son,
And give Him the glory,
Great things He has done.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O perfect redemption,
The purchase of blood,
To every believer
The promise of God;
The vilest offender
Who truly believes,
That moment from Jesus
A pardon receives.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father,
Through Jesus the Son,
And give Him the glory,
Great things He has done.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Great things He has taught us,
Great things He has done,
And great our rejoicing
Through Jesus the Son;
But purer, and higher,
And greater will be
Our wonder, our transport,
When Jesus we see.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father,
Through Jesus the Son,
And give Him the glory,
Great things He has done.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When we walk with the Lord
In the light of His Word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will,
He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Trust and obey,
For there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not a shadow can rise,
Not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt or a fear,
Not a sigh or a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Trust and obey,
For there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Not a burden we bear,
Not a sorrow we share,
But our toil He doth richly repay;
Not a grief or a loss,
Not a frown or a cross,
But is blessed if we trust and obey.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Trust and obey,
For there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: But we never can prove
The delights of His love
Until all on the altar we lay;
For the favour He shows,
For the joy He bestows,
Are for them who will trust and obey.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Trust and obey,
For there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Then in fellowship sweet
We will sit at His feet.
Or we'll walk by His side in the way.
What He says we will do,
Where He sends we will go;
Never fear, only trust and obey.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Trust and obey,
For there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

songs.title: We Plough the Fields and Scatter
songs.author: Matthias Claudius (1740–1815); tr. Jane M. Campbell (1817–1878)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We plough the fields, and scatter
The good seed on the land,
But it is fed and watered
By God's almighty hand;
He sends the snow in winter,
The warmth to swell the grain,
The breezes and the sunshine,
And soft refreshing rain.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All good gifts around us
Are sent from Heaven above,
Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord
For all His love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He only is the Maker
Of all things near and far;
He paints the wayside flower,
He lights the evening star;
The winds and waves obey Him,
By Him the birds are fed;
Much more to us, His children,
He gives our daily bread.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All good gifts around us
Are sent from Heaven above,
Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord
For all His love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We thank Thee, then, O Father,
For all things bright and good,
The seed time and the harvest,
Our life, our health, and food;
No gifts have we to offer,
For all Thy love imparts,
But that which Thou desirest,
Our humble, thankful hearts.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: All good gifts around us
Are sent from Heaven above,
Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord
For all His love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We three kings of Orient are;
Bearing gifts we traverse afar,
Field and fountain, moor and mountain,
Following yonder star.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O star of wonder, star of light,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to thy perfect light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Born a king on Bethlehem's plain
Gold I bring to crown Him again,
King forever, ceasing never,
Over us all to reign.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O star of wonder, star of light,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to thy perfect light.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Frankincense to offer have I;
Incense owns a deity nigh;
Prayer and praising, voices raising,
Worshiping God on high.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O star of wonder, star of light,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to thy perfect light.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Myrrh is mine, its bitter perfume
Breathes a life of gathering gloom;
Sorrowing, sighing, bleeding, dying,
Sealed in the stone cold tomb.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O star of wonder, star of light,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to thy perfect light.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Glorious now behold Him arise;
King and God and sacrifice;
Alleluia, Alleluia,
Sounds through the earth and skies.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: O star of wonder, star of light,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to thy perfect light.

songs.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus
songs.author: Joseph M. Scriven (1819–1886)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
O what peace we often forfeit,
O what needless pain we bear,
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Are we weak and heavy laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do your friends despise, forsake you?
Take it to the Lord in prayer!
In His arms He'll take and shield you;
You will find a solace there.

songs.title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross
songs.author: Isaac Watts (1674–1748)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of glory died,
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ my God!
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them to His blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: See from His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down!
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Were the whole realm of nature mine,
That were a present far too small;
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

songs.title: When the Roll Is Called Up Yonder
songs.author: James M. Black (1856–1938)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound,
And time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks, eternal, bright and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather
Over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: When the roll, is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder
I'll be there.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On that bright and cloudless morning
When the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurrection share;
When His chosen ones shall gather
To their home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: When the roll, is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder
I'll be there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us labour for the Master
From the dawn till setting sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and care;
Then when all of life is over,
And our work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: When the roll, is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder
I'll be there.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
All seated on the ground,
The angel of the Lord came down,
And glory shone around,
And glory shone around.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Fear not! said he, for mighty dread
Had seized their troubled mind.
"Glad tidings of great joy I bring
To you and all mankind
To you and all mankind.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: "To you, in David's town, this day
Is born of David's line
A Saviour, who is Christ the Lord,
And this shall be the sign,
And this shall be the sign.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The heav'nly Babe you there shall find
To human view displayed,
All meanly wrapped in swathing bands,
And in a manger laid,
And in a manger laid.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thus spake the seraph and forthwith
Appeared a shining throng
Of angels praising God on high,
Who thus addressed their song,
Who thus addressed their song:

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: All glory be to God on high,
And to the Earth be peace;
Good will henceforth from Heav'n to men
Begin and never cease,
Begin and never cease!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Will your anchor hold in the storms of life,
When the clouds unfold their wings of strife?
When the strong tides lift and the cables strain,
Will your anchor drift, or firm remain?

sections.label: Chorus
lines: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour's love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: It is safely moored, 'twill the storm withstand,
For 'tis well secured by the Saviour's hand;
And the cables, passed from His heart to mine,
Can defy that blast, thro' strength divine.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour's love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: It will surely hold in the Straits of Fear—
When the breakers have told that the reef is near;
Though the tempest rave and the wild winds blow,
Not an angry wave shall our bark o'erflow.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour's love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: It will firmly hold in the Floods of Death—
When the waters cold chill our latest breath,
On the rising tide it can never fail,
While our hopes abide within the Veil.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour's love.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: When our eyes behold through the gath'ring night
The city of gold, our harbour bright,
We shall anchor fast by the heav'nly shore,
With the storms all past forevermore.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour's love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing them over again to me,
Wonderful words of life,
Let me more of their beauty see,
Wonderful words of life;
Words of life and beauty
Teach me faith and duty.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life,
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ, the blessed One, gives to all
Wonderful words of life;
Sinner, list to the loving call,
Wonderful words of life;
All so freely given, wooing us to Heaven.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life,
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sweetly echo the Gospel call,
Wonderful words of life;
Offer pardon and peace to all,
Wonderful words of life;
Jesus, only Saviour, sanctify us forever.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life,
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ye servants of God, your master proclaim,
And publish abroad His wonderful name;
The name all victorious of Jesus extol,
His kingdom is glorious and rules over all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God ruleth on high, almighty to save,
And still He is nigh, His presence we have;
The great congregation His triumph shall sing,
Ascribing salvation to Jesus our king.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Salvation to God, who sits on the throne,
Let all cry aloud and honour the Son!
The praises of Jesus the angels proclaim,
Fall down on their faces and worship the Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then let us adore, and give Him His right,
All glory and power, and wisdom and might;
All honour and blessing, with angels above,
And thanks never ceasing, and infinite love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Yield not to temptation,
For yielding is sin;
Each victory will help you
Some other to win;
Fight manfully onward,
Dark passions subdue,
Look ever to Jesus,
He'll carry you through.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Ask the Saviour to help you,
Comfort, strengthen and keep you;
He is willing to aid you,
He will carry you through.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shun evil companions,
Bad language disdain,
God's name hold in reverence,
Nor take it in vain;
Be thoughtful and earnest,
Kindhearted and true,
Look ever to Jesus,
He'll carry you through.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Ask the Saviour to help you,
Comfort, strengthen and keep you;
He is willing to aid you,
He will carry you through.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To him that o'ercometh,
God giveth a crown;
Through faith we shall conquer,
Though often cast down;
He who is our Saviour
Our strength will renew;
Look ever to Jesus,
He'll carry you through.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Ask the Saviour to help you,
Comfort, strengthen and keep you;
He is willing to aid you,
He will carry you through.
